verdict.rationale: Lithic exposes an extensive documented REST API covering cards, disputes, webhooks, KYC, spend limits, and versioning headers, plus reference pages for direct endpoint invocation, showing a fully documented public API surface an AI-native user could drive programmatically. Missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI/swagger spec (probe returned 404s on standard paths) and independent third-party corroboration of API usability.
